title: Metropolis DLMM VaultFactory + OracleRewardVault/Strategy vault-side auth (Sonic)

Factory admin fns are onlyOwner (Gnosis Safe 0xd1f2823f...); initialize4 is reinitializer(6) and slot0 _initialized==6

Vault value-movers gated by onlyFactory/onlyOperators/onlyStrategy; strategy by onlyVault/onlyOperators/onlyFactory/onlyDefaultOperator/onlyTrusted
claim()/updateAccRewardsPerShare are permissionless but self-scoped to the caller's own shares/rewards
Operators are EOAs/Safes; two are EIP-7702-delegated to EIP7702StatelessDeleGator whose execute() reverts NotEntryPointOrSelf
